sources.title: Evidence base
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's evidence base covers homes, economy, movement, environment, infrastructure and viability and includes a 2023 HELAA plus 2024 infrastructure material; document dates vary and are retained explicitly.

sources.title: What is planning policy?
sources.verified_claim: Havering confirms its 2021 Local Plan and Policies Map remain adopted planning policy while infrastructure planning supports growth identified in the plan.

sources.title: Adopted Local Development Plan Documents
sources.verified_claim: Havering records formal adoption of the Local Plan on 17 November 2021; adopted status is kept separate from the current Local Plan update and new evidence gathering.

sources.title: Business and Jobs evidence base
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's business and jobs evidence catalogue contains employment, office, industrial and KIBA studies mainly from 2015-2020; this evidence is useful context but is not treated as a current parcel-level employment forecast.

sources.title: Transport and communications evidence
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's transport evidence includes the 2019 Transport Strategy and implementation plan plus older baseline studies; evidence age is retained as a limitation.

sources.title: Viability evidence
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth lists a 2019 Local Plan and Community Infrastructure Levy Viability Review and related workspace analysis; these are plan evidence and do not establish viability of the sample parcel today.

sources.title: Quality of the built environment
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's built-environment evidence includes local distinctiveness, conservation-area and heritage-setting studies with varying dates; design/heritage constraints are retained without exact parcel inference.

sources.title: Places and Neighbourhoods
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's places and neighbourhoods evidence includes OAKDA, Brixton, Waterloo, Streatham and West Norwood/Tulse Hill frameworks, mostly pre-2020; these provide place context, not exact parcel applicability.
